title: eludite.editor.toggle_inlay_hints input
description: Show or hide inlay hints (Edit > IntelliSense > Toggle Inline Hints, Alt+F1; brief 0066): the inline parameter names and inferred types the language server reports, drawn as chips that are not text. It flips whether hints show in every editor for this session; the settings editor.inlayHints.* are unchanged. With `enabled` it sets the state instead of flipping it.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document whose hints the output counts. Omit for the active document.

enabled.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the hints; omit to flip.
